categories.name: Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning
categories.description: Leverage Machine Learning APIs to interpret data, identify patterns, and make predictive decisions. These APIs act as an intermediary, connecting user queries to predictive answers by tapping into complex datasets.

categories.name: Finance
categories.description: Finance APIs provide a wide range of services for financial management, including account access, transaction processing, and real-time market data. They offer features such as stock market news, trading capabilities, and cryptocurrency information.

categories.name: Search

categories.name: Communication

categories.name: Mapping
